scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @agent-control-plane/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web
scripts.build:mobile:android: npm run prebuild -w @agent-control-plane/mobile && npm run apk:release -w @agent-control-plane/mobile
scripts.build:mobile:debug: npm run prebuild -w @agent-control-plane/mobile && npm run apk:debug -w @agent-control-plane/mobile
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @agent-control-plane/domain && npm run build -w @agent-control-plane/ui && npm run build -w @agent-control-plane/mobile-ui && npm run build -w @agent-control-plane/config
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:mobile
scripts.lint: eslint apps/web apps/mobile packages/domain packages/ui packages/mobile-ui packages/config
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck:mobile
